1. Verify bill arithmetic: confirm meter difference (50,037 − 48,846 = 1,191 kWh), line-item sum ($18.79 + $41.42 + $158.39 = $218.60), and total change vs. last month ($218.60 − $145.11 = +$73.49).
2. Separate fixed vs. variable charges: treat the $18.79 customer charge as fixed per period; infer last month’s variable total ($145.11 − $18.79 = $126.32) and last month’s variable rate ($126.32 / 753 kWh).
3. Compute current variable rate ($199.81 / 1,191 kWh) and derive price_usd as the rate change applied to last month’s usage.
4. Derive usage_usd as the current variable rate applied to the usage change (1,191 − 753 kWh); set days_usd = 0 (fixed customer charge, no per-day charge) and weather_usd = 0 (no weather data provided).
5. Check that price_usd + days_usd + weather_usd + usage_usd equals the total change; inspect meter reads and line-item totals for any billing error and set billing_error_suspected / billing_error_usd accordingly.
6. Output only the JSON object with the six required keys.
